profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin Space
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin Space. Member of the Engineering Leadership Development Program class of 2027. Bachelor’s in Computer Science Major at University of Colorado class of 2022. Master’s in Engineering Management at Cornell University class of 2027.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Plan, conduct, and coordinate software development activities. Design, develop, document, test, and debug software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems. Apply the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle.

positions.title: iSAT AI Project (CU Boulder)
positions.description:
Through a work sponsor with CU Boulder, 
Software Engineer Role:
•	Developing full-stack web applications that collect, analyze, and process data. (Node.js, REACT)
•	Managing and debugging code deliverables in GitHub and ensuring deadlines are met. 
Project Manager Role:
•	Voted on by 7 Computer Science team members to be Project Manager. 
•	Leading our team in developing AI to assist teachers in the classroom. (Microsoft MakeCode & JavaScript)

positions.title: Engineering Peer Mentor
positions.description:
Engineering Peer Mentor | University of Colorado 
•	Teaching and helping new students adapt to the engineering curriculum at CU.
•	Grading assignments and giving feedback to students on various engineering subjects.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Developer
positions.description:
CU Computer Science Department School Project.
Software Developer | UCartify | University of Colorado
•	Launched an app that saves information from shopping websites such as price, location, etc.
•	Designed and programmed HTML and CSS for design and layout of app.
•	Created sign-up page to save over thousands of returning users’ information.
•	Lead and collaborated with 4 other students to successfully launch the app before the deadline.

positions.title: House Manager
positions.description:
House Manager | Pi Kappa Phi Fraternity
•	Voted by 180 of my peers to manage quality control of the fraternity house. 
•	Communicated constantly with contractors, tenants, nationals, and other businesses.
